gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-gothi: Funnel Display's strokes run like spaghetti, one width from end to end. Noto Sans Gothic, a sans-serif, does the quieter job, giving its lowercase big, bead-round counters where the heading brings the loud, uniform line.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-grant: Noto Sans Grantha stands tall, its bowls pressed flat like pen nibs. Funnel Display lays down pencil-like lines that never thicken or thin, and the sans text beneath glides past without catching on a closed bowl.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-gunja: Noto Sans Gunjala Gondi has tall, crayon-thick lowercase strokes and terminals cut back to leave a gap. But Funnel Display, by contrast, never lets its pen line change width from start to finish.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-gurmu: Funnel Display builds every letter from a unit-width stroke, spaghetti-like and unbroken. Noto Sans Gurmukhi takes care of the reading, with outward-pointing terminals like tongs and ascenders that barely clear the x-height.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-hanun: Noto Sans Hanunoo reads easily, its lowercase filling most of the line height and its terminals left open. Funnel Display adds a drafted, blueprint-like line of constant weight overhead.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-hebre: Funnel Display has no modulation between stems and connecting strokes. It earns its keep big and brief, while Noto Sans Hebrew gives the text a dominant midsection and wide gaps between curve ends and stems.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-hk: Funnel Display looks bent from one length of tubing, each letter carrying a single constant line from end to end. Noto Sans HK loosens it with large lowercase and lifted brush ends.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-imper: Funnel Display gives its bowls the full weight of its stems. Make it small and that constant line loses its punch, while Noto Sans Imperial Aramaic keeps pincer-like c ends and a short step to capitals.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-inscr: Funnel Display is built on a flat, unvarying line weight in every letter. Noto Sans Inscriptional Parthian, a sans with big open eyes on every e and a, is the one that handles the reading.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-jp: Funnel Display is bold without ever swelling or thinning. Noto Sans JP, with a very tall x-height and curves that sweep open, would carry paragraphs with a smooth, unhurried feel.
